laneHardStops.interpretation: A threshold crossing is a recorded algorithm-lane failure outcome; it never authorizes a lane retry, partial resume, or same-algorithm replacement.

replacementPolicy.algorithmSpecificFailure: retain as an outcome; no retry or replacement
replacementPolicy.infrastructureFailureBeforeAnyAlgorithmO: void the whole six-lane superblock and permit at most one documented whole-superblock replacement in the entire formal collection
replacementPolicy.replacementMustUse: a precommitted spare input generated and frozen before collection, with all six lanes rerun from fresh processes

technicalFailClosed: Any contract, hash, schema, cardinality, ordinal, trusted-identity, correctness, oracle-cache, or source-binding mismatch stops the active execution and preserves all evidence. A new execution attempt requires a separately frozen readiness and authorization; observations from failed attempts cannot be merged into a later successful root.
scientificCompletion: Complete only after all planned nonvoid superblocks and permitted precommitted replacement, if any, have terminal trusted natural-exit evidence and the independent read-only delivery acceptance passes.
